What We Do

OUR PROGRAMS

We put boots on the ground for Fortune 500 clients across three high-impact programs — putting real solutions in the hands of real people.

01
📱

Lifeline Program

Government-backed discounted phone services connecting low-income households to essential communication — jobs, education, and emergency access.

02

Home Internet

Top nationwide internet providers delivering affordable broadband to low-income households. We're the connection between communities and the digital world.

03

ACA Program

Affordable Care Act enrollment specialists guiding people through healthcare reform, subsidies, and pre-existing condition protections.

Opportunities

CAREER PATHS

Every role below is a rung on the same ladder. We hire for hunger, not résumé. Where you start doesn't determine where you finish.

Entry Level · Start Here

Field Agent

$600 – $1,000 / week · Performance Based

You are the first line of contact for new and existing customers. Learn, memorize, and demonstrate our proven customer service and sales principles for Fortune 500 clients — then help manage your own field marketing campaign. Student mentality and elite service skills are the only prerequisites.

CommunicationCustomer ServiceMarketingStudent Mentality
Apply Now →
Leadership Track

Team Leader

$800 – $1,200 / week · Performance Based

Accountable for the teaching, training, and development of others. Manage team accounts in sales, compliance, and training on a daily basis. This role demands strong work ethic, great attitude, and genuine people skills — no exceptions.

Team TrainingRecruitingComplianceTerritory Management
Apply Now →
Management Track · Flagship Role

Market Manager

$75,000+ / year · Performance Based

Full brand management plus territory-wide accountability. Keep sales and compliance at or above client standards — and push relentlessly to over-achieve. You're involved in admin, recruiting, interviews, conference calls, and financials. Every manager started at entry level. No exceptions.

P&LInterviewingConference LeadershipFinancials
Apply Now →

1099 Independent Contractor Disclosure
This is a 1099 Independent Contractor position only. You do NOT work for Williams Marketing & Management, Inc. as an employee. You will be responsible for paying your own taxes, travel expenses to and from work locations, and must have access to or own a tablet with data to perform job duties. You must have reliable transportation with the ability to carry all products and materials needed for work. As an independent contractor, you will be trained and once trained, left to perform the required jobs independently. A manager's role is to train and assist when needed — this does not include transportation or setting up tents, tables, chairs, etc. Our managers are dedicated to assisting in all other areas to ensure you have every opportunity available to us all.
By submitting you agree to the 1099 contractor terms above.
